title: Black hole lensing
summary: A point mass bends a star field and a glowing band into an Einstein ring. Move the pointer to drag the black hole around.

title: Compute-shader boids
summary: 2,048 flocking birds simulated on the GPU. A compute pass updates two ping-pong storage buffers, then a render pass draws them.

title: Depth-tested 3D cube
summary: A lit, spinning cube with a perspective matrix, an index buffer, back-face culling and a depth texture that follows the canvas size.

title: Game of life
summary: Conway's cellular automaton on the GPU. A compute pass steps the grid, cells fade color with age. Click to reseed.

title: Image blur with compute
summary: A compute shader draws a test image into a storage texture, then a two-pass separable Gaussian-style blur softens it. The radius breathes in and out.

title: Instanced particle galaxy
summary: 24,000 glowing particles drawn with one instanced draw call, read from a storage buffer, with additive blending.

title: Mandelbrot zoom
summary: An endless zoom into the Mandelbrot set with smooth coloring, computed per pixel in a fragment shader.

title: Raymarched SDF scene
summary: A sphere melts into a rounded box above a floor, rendered in a fragment shader with signed distance fields, soft shadows and a mouse-orbit camera.

title: Texture sampling
summary: An 8 by 8 pixel image uploaded with writeTexture and drawn twice: nearest filtering on the left, linear on the right.

title: Spinning triangle
summary: The smallest complete WebGPU program: one render pipeline, a uniform buffer and a vertex-colored triangle.
